messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: DETECTED 03:14:12 UTC — sustained spike in 5xx and connection resets from inference endpoints in us-west-2a. Alert rule: inference-error-rate > 5% for 2m. Affected service: inference-rt-prod (route tags: model=optimize-v2).

Mia Chen: oncall? whats the blast radius?

Sanjay Patel: I'm on it. quick check: net telemetry shows RX drops and NAPI stall on host pool usw2a-g5-*. kernel logs show repeated messages about 'rx softirq deferred' and 'device xmit requeue'. grabbing logs now.

Sanjay Patel: log snippet:
```
Mar 15 03:12:58 host-004 kernel: eth0: rx-queue 1 stalled, rx drops 4234
Mar 15 03:13:01 host-004 kernel: WARNING: NAPI poll timeout on cpu 2
Mar 15 03:13:05 host-004 kernel: ENI eni-0abcde: tx timeout
```

Tess Nguyen: AWS Health dashboard shows a networking event in us-west-2a (reported degraded networking for instances in a subset of AZ racks). link: https://status.aws/incident/us-west-2a (internal shortened link).

Eva López: Observed 502s from the NLB -> targets failing health check intermittently. p95 latency for generate endpoint jumped from 420ms to 1.2s in the last 6m.

Jordan (CS): customer impact check — CX telemetry: ~12% of inference requests returned 5xx, top complaints from two enterprise tenants in us-west-2 region. no data exfil. working on a customer note but prefer to confirm mitigation first.

Amit Singh: I'm initiating traffic steering from us-west-2a to us-west-2b with smart-routing. starting canary shift at 03:18. command: 
```
redwoodctl route set --from-region=us-west-2a --to-region=us-west-2b --weight=0.6 --dry-run=false
```
also draining affected nodes in us-west-2a: 
```
redwoodctl cluster drain --cluster=inference-prod-usw2a --grace-period=30s --concurrency=4
```

ProductSam: note — model variants in us-west-2b are slightly different quantization profile; enable fallback to quantized-v1 so customers don't see degradations if larger variant not ready.

Mia Chen: Sanjay, can you confirm if this is host-level (NIC/firmware) vs network fabric?

Sanjay Patel: initial root cause leans host NIC firmware or local rack switch fabric. ENI attach logs show repeated device detach/reattach on a subset of instances, not broad control plane. AWS SR open by Tess.

Tess Nguyen: AWS SR update — they've acknowledged increased packet discard in a rack cluster affecting egress for a small percentage of instances. Their mitigation is to move impacted instances or rehome traffic. ETA uncertain.

Eva López: meanwhile, ramping up capacity in us-west-2b and warming KV cache to reduce cold misses. autoscaling command run: 
```
aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name=inf-prod-usw2b-asg --desired-capacity 24
```

deploy-bot: deploy 03:19:12 — started rollout of cache-warm job to us-west-2b (job id cw-20260315-0319).

ProductSam: also enabling model-variant fallback in routing layer to prefer smaller model if latency spikes. command: 
```
redwoodctl model fallback set --service=inference-rt-prod --policy=latency-first --fallback=quantized-v1
```

Sanjay Patel: quick smoke test from edge into us-west-2a shows intermittent conn reset: 
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -d '{input: test}'
* Connected to lb 10.0.0.5
* Received HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
* Connection reset by peer
```
After steering 60% to us-west-2b, error rate dropped to ~4% and p95 to 680ms. still seeing tail errors for requests that hit warm hosts in 2a.

Mia Chen: good. Plan: 1) continue steering to 2b to keep error <5% 2) drain and replace affected hosts in 2a 3) AWS does rehoming — coordinate 4) prepare customer comms if errors persist >30m.

Jordan (CS): agreed. drafting a short status for impacted customers: minimal service disruption, automatic failover in progress. will wait 15m for stabilization.

Amit Singh: handoff note — night oncall (Amit) will remain lead for next shift. paging policy invoked. pinging backup oncall now.

Mia Chen: handoff detail: I will be primary for next 10m until handoff completed, then Amit takes over. log timeline and keep runbook link handy: https://confluence/internal/runbooks/inference-network-az-impairment

Tess Nguyen: AWS SR 123456 opened. AWS suggests instance relocation for affected host pool; they're starting automated rehoming.

Sanjay Patel: root cause hypothesis: NIC firmware + transient rack-level fabric issue causing packet drops and NLB target failures. long-term: consider spreading critical capacity across AZ racks and adjust health-check thresholds.

ProductSam: ops action items noted: update smart-routing to include gradational fallback to other regions, add proactive cache warmup on region fallbacks, add a runbook step for immediate model-variant fallback.

Jordan (CS): customer note sent at 03:38 UTC to impacted tenants (internal copy).

deploy-bot: action log — 03:20 drain started, 03:22 routing policy updated, 03:23 asg scale up triggered, 03:31 cache warm job completed in us-west-2b.

Mia Chen: monitoring: keep error-rate and p95 on watch. if error rate >5% for another 15m we escalate to incident-review and send broader customer comms.

Amit Singh: taking over. will coordinate with Tess for AWS rehoming status and with Sanjay for host replacements. handing off chat to incident channel for postmortem drafting.

ProductSam: post-incident checklist: tag teams: SRE, NETENG, ML-runtime, CustSuccess. create postmortem doc and link on timeline.

Mia Chen: thanks all — posting short incident update to #incidents-summary after stabilization.

(End of thread)
